title: Agnus Dei (Lechner, Missa Domine dominus noster)
desc: Leonhard Lechner, Missa Domine dominus noster, Agnus Dei, 1584. 6 voices (Cantus, Sexta vox, Altus, Tenor, Quinta vox, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0049_5); edited by Franz Körndle, Vincent Besson, Kévin Roger, Simon Popp, Jonathan Stroh. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
